recap.text: Yolanda Martinez is a level five CNA in medical scrubs who uses a bow and a large quiver. She reaches level nine after deflating Mind Horrors and helping Brandon kill a blimp boss. When Jack relieves himself on a train wall, Yolanda shoots him in the temple and a rage elemental cuts through her. A player-killer skull icon forms over her head as she unravels in a red cloud.

The Royal Court of Princess Donut joins the guild Safehome Yolanda, controlled by Team Meadowlark. Guildmaster Imani C is level seven with six parties and sixty-three crawlers. Yolanda was one of Imani's best friends, and the name hits Crawler Carl like a punch to the gut. A door labelled Guild Common Area appears beside the saferoom exit.

beats.headline: Meadow Lark. Yolanda. CNA.
beats.text: For the record: Yolanda Martinez 13, about fifty, four foot eleven, level five, one bronze star. Medical scrubs, a bow, a quiver so big it almost drags on the floor, and a plastic ID reading "Meadow Lark. Yolanda. CNA." She greets Crawler Carl with enthusiasm. When he proposes a bomb for the boss, she has already tested its little viewing doors: they are protected, an arrow bounces off, and a finger meets something like thick clay that glows blue. "I wouldn't be pushing no bomb through that."
beats.gist: Yolanda Martinez is a level five CNA from Meadow Lark who greets Crawler Carl with enthusiasm.

beats.headline: A brace to the head
beats.text: Agatha wheels her cart in behind them. "No, Agatha, don't!" Yolanda yells, to no effect. In the drilled routine she slides the angled braces out of her inventory one after another, circling the fort. When the Ball of Swine hits, a ceiling brace pops out and throws her over. When the walls come down, she is on the ground with her health alarmingly low, and Imani is standing over her, screaming and swinging a sword.
beats.gist: Yolanda slides angled braces around the fort, but a ceiling brace throws her over.

beats.headline: Randall, don't come in here
beats.text: Imani feeds her a health potion, and she sits up holding the side of her head. With blood still all over her own face, she takes out a cloth and cleans Agatha's. She explains that Agatha has no inventory because she has not done the tutorial. She is level six now. When an elderly man with a walker starts clicking into the boss chamber to see what the noise was, she jogs to head him off. "Randall, don't come in here!"
beats.gist: Yolanda Martinez is a level six crawler.

beats.headline: Adult pads for Jack
beats.text: She walks residents to the bathrooms. Her boss box gives her a new kind of quiver. When the recap leaves out Agatha's picture she asks whether that means she is dead. Then the dungeon announces the rage elemental rule for anyone who relieves themselves outside a bathroom, and Brandon tells her to warn Jack. Yolanda goes pale. "I have a few adult pads left. I'll make sure he puts one on."
beats.gist: Yolanda walks residents to bathrooms and gets a new quiver from her boss box.

beats.headline: Deflating the Mind Horrors
beats.text: She went out with the Andrews brothers to clear the Mind Horrors, shooting the floating brains from down the hallway and deflating them before they could reach anyone. The boss, a blimp, went down easily, by Brandon's account thanks to Yolanda. She is level nine now, equal with both brothers. On the march she barks with laughter when Mrs. McGibbons propositions Crawler Carl, tells Jack not to be crude, and walks at the rear with her bow ready.
beats.gist: Yolanda shoots and deflates floating Mind Horrors with the Andrews brothers and reaches level nine.

beats.headline: A nurse her entire life
beats.text: Jack stood up on the train and relieved himself on the wall. Yolanda put an arrow through his temple, a fraction too late. Her arrows shattered against the rage elemental that rose from the stain, and she stood over Randall, thrown from the last car, while it finished forming. It cut through them both. Yolanda Martinez, nurse all her life, who worked sixty-hour weeks to put her son through college, unravelled in a red cloud. The creature did not break stride.
beats.gist: Yolanda Martinez, a lifelong nurse, unravels in a red cloud after a creature cuts through her.

beats.headline: A skull over her head
beats.text: The recap plays it in slow motion. Jack at the wall, Yolanda's horrified face, Crawler Donut leaping, the arrow into his temple, and a player-killer skull icon slowly forming over Yolanda's head as he falls from the platform. Imani cannot watch and gets up and turns away. At the end of the episode the show replays her death from the beginning, in gruesome detail. Mrs. McGibbons's eulogy, delivered on the safe room floor before the episode airs: "Poor Yolanda. She was such a good kid."
beats.gist: A recap shows Yolanda's face as Donut takes an arrow to the temple and a skull forms.

beats.headline: A guild called Safehome Yolanda
beats.text: The Royal Court of Princess Donut is now a member of the guild Safehome Yolanda. Controlling party: Team Meadowlark. Guildmaster: crawler Imani C. Level seven, six parties, sixty-three crawlers. Despite their age difference, Yolanda was one of Imani's best friends, and the name lands on Crawler Carl like a punch to the gut. A new door appears beside the saferoom exit, labelled Guild Common Area.
beats.gist: The Royal Court of Princess Donut joins Safehome Yolanda, a guild led by level seven Imani C.
